notes.title: Patch Notes V0.0.4
notes.content:
Hey Couriers!
Today, we've added some new features to enhance your gaming experience. 🚚✨

Change List:
The motorcycle repair center is now open. The repair area has been moved indoors.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657080/bd8db5a873d3895b44bd7ceaed64ade3411a667b.jpg"]  

A bug that occurred when motorcycles were recovered using the R key has been fixed. The recovery height has been reduced. Visual and audio elements have been added during recovery.

Engine start sounds have been added when mounting motorcycles. Each motorcycle has a unique sound design.

The rate at which motorcycle health and fuel decrease has been increased.

A bug related to the helmet worn when riding motorcycles has been fixed.

The location synchronization issue of the package launched from the catapult has been fixed.



Ride safe and stay tuned! 🚴‍♂️

Crixel Games.

notes.title: Patch Notes V0.0.3
notes.content:
Hey Couriers!
Today, we've added some new features to enhance your gaming experience. 🚚✨

Change List:
The order times have been increased from 02:30 to 03:00.

A new app called "Orders" has been added to your phone. You can now get navigation to delivery addresses more easily.

The navigation directions on the mini map have been improved. Incorrect markings have been corrected.

Collision sounds have been added to the motorcycles.

The waiting time to get on the motorcycle has been reduced.

A helpful tip now appears at 22:00 to remind you that you can end your day.

Some helper key tips have been repositioned and improved.

A new red button has been added to turn off the phone.

You can now exit computers and other interface screens using the ESC key.

The end-of-day summary screen has been improved with a better user interface.



Ride safe and stay tuned! 🚴‍♂️

Crixel Games.

notes.title: Patch Notes V0.0.2
notes.content:
Hey Couriers!
Today, we've added some new features to enhance your gaming experience. 🚚✨

Change List:
Catapult tasks now give 5 times more tips.

A new stage has been added at the end of the game's tutorial section, where you can purchase the 'Bobber' motorcycle.

The TPS camera's rotation control in motorcycles has been improved.

The visibility of spikes on some roads has been increased for easier spotting from a distance.

A button has been added to the main menu to show the updates added to the game (Patch Notes).



Ride safe and stay tuned! 🚴‍♂️

Crixel Games.

notes.title: Patch Notes V0.0.1
notes.content:
Hey Couriers!
We’ve just rolled out a new update that squashes some annoying bugs and introduces a brand-new feature to improve your delivery experience. 🚚✨

Change List:
Motorcycle damage has been significantly reduced.

The number of spikes on certain roads that caused tire punctures has been decreased.

Restore Function – If your bike gets stuck, press R to restore it! You can also check out all controls from the panel on the right side of the screen while riding.

Fixed an issue where players could fly out of the map through certain gaps.

Fixed a bug related to the functionality of the V-Sync option in the graphics settings.



Ride safe and stay tuned! 🚴‍♂️

Crixel Games.
